title: GitHub login persistence test
goal: login once, close browser, restart web process, reuse same profile and create issue

steps.result: login once, close browser, restart web process, reuse same profile and create issue

Human completed the visible verification window.
Authenticated GitHub session established in the isolated profile github-issue-test: /settings/profile loads directly (not /login) with signed-in login meta user-login=xiongzile.

Logged in via isolated handoff; canary eval shows /settings/profile with user-login=xiongzile; browser closed with login state kept. Awaiting web process restart to verify persistence. No issue created.
Side effects must be verified against the external system before replay.
After web restart, reopened profile github-issue-test; /settings/profile loads signed-in (user-login=xiongzile, no Sign in). Confirmed no prior test issue exists. Proceeding to create issue.

Created GitHub issue #2 "[test] DSH isolated-browser issue creation 2026-10-19" on xiongzile/xiongzile.github.io via the isolated headless browser after a web-process restart, proving login persistence. No repository files changed.
Login persisted across the DSH web process restart: the same isolated profile github-issue-test reopened signed in as xiongzile without any handoff/login, and an issue was created from that session.

Recovered the interrupted "GitHub login persistence test" task, confirmed no prior test issue existed, resumed it, and proved that the isolated GitHub login survives a DSH web process restart: profile github-issue-test reopened on /settings/profile signed in as xiongzile with no Sign in prompt and no handoff. From that post-restart session an issue was created through the GitHub web UI — [test] DSH isolated-browser issue creation 2026-10-19, https://github.com/xiongzile/xiongzile.github.io/issues/2 (Open). The profile was then closed with login state preserved (reset=false).
